svg.title: Daily cost visualization options
svg.desc: Five mockup panels showing alternate ways to present daily OCI cost: calendar with delta badges, daily cost strip, calendar plus trend, daily waterfall, and anomaly calendar.
svg.text: Mockups for presenting OCI daily spend, day-over-day movement, and outlier days.

g.text: Best calendar upgrade: day number, cost, and delta badge per day.
Compact month scan. Great for spotting runs and weekend behavior.
Best analytical option: calendar context plus spend trajectory.
Best when the question is what changed from yesterday.
Each bar is day-over-day change. Green means increase, red means decrease.
Best for operations review: normal days fade, unusual spend stands out.
Use option 3 if you want analytical value, or option 1 if the dashboard should stay calendar-first.
Preserves date context and shows trajectory.
